data.name: Whale Simulator
data.detailed_description:
This is a game about watching livestreams.

Put plainly — a whale simulator.

You are a cat. A cat who somehow ended up with an absurd amount of money.

Late one night you scroll into a talent stream. The girl on stage isn't the best dancer there. But something about the way she talks makes you stop. You tap a gift without thinking, and she reads your name out loud.

And that was that.

She becomes "your streamer" — the one you show up for. Her story gets to you, and you decide you're going to put her on top of that leaderboard. Just don't forget you have a life of your own to run.

Sixty days later you'll either have it all, or walk away with nothing. That part is on you.

【A livestream is a small society】

Seven female streamers, four male streamers, all sharing one room. They battle head-to-head on a split screen — the winner holds the stage, the loser goes to the back of the line.

You never perform. You're just watching.

But every gift you send rewrites the fight — who you back, when you back them, how hard. Gifts of the same type chain into combos, combos light up the room, and once the room is hot, strangers start spending alongside you.

That's what carrying someone looks like. It feels like spending. It's closer to investing.

【She remembers you】

Real AI conversation. Not a dialogue tree.

Because you sent gifts, she looks after you — messaging you after the stream ends, asking how your day went. Talk long enough and you'll hit the things she keeps quiet about: family, someone she can't let go of, a plan she's afraid to say out loud.

Maybe you can help her untangle it. Maybe you can't.

Every streamer has her own storyline, and their lives are tangled with each other. Everything you say is remembered, and all of it decides which ending she reaches.

If your model supports image generation, you can send her a photo — it lands like a gift. She'll answer with one of her own, generated on the spot.

【Collect, then do it all again】

Collect every streamer's photos. Collect the endings you haven't seen.

The same sixty days, spent on someone else, is a completely different story.

【About AI】

The game ships with a starting allowance of conversation credits. Install it and play; nothing to configure.

After release, additional credit packs will be available through Steam in-app purchases.

And — you can always bring your own API key instead. That option is open from day one and will never be removed. We're putting that promise on the store page, and we mean it.

【The stage】

Hundreds of dance performances. All music is original, AI-generated, and owned by us — and you can drop in your own MP3s to build the room you want.

Steam Workshop supported — the moments you and your streamer make together can be shared with everyone.

【Who this is for】

People who like livestreams.

People who like dance.

People who watch every night but never have the money to tip.

People who did tip, and got their heart broken for it.

You're home.

Back your streamer. See you at the top.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 5090 32g
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

data.legal_notice:
© 2026 Shanghai MagicCat Information Technology Co., Ltd. All rights reserved. MagicCat and Whale Simulator are trademarks of Shanghai MagicCat Information Technology Co., Ltd.

This product includes developer-created content made with generative AI. Optional online features may use third-party AI services. Depictions of characters are fictional and do not represent real people.

content_descriptors.notes:
"This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. It contains General Mature Content, and may include Nudity or Sexual Content.

Specifically, the game features two types of visual content:

1. Live-Action Content: Features real actors performing dances. These segments are strictly compliant, with actors wearing standard, appropriate attire. There is no explicit or suggestive content involving real people.
2. AI-Generated Content: Features AI-generated character artwork. Some of these virtual characters may have exaggerated body proportions and may be depicted wearing swimsuits or similar beachwear.

The game does not contain any explicit sexual activity, pornography, or full nudity."
